fullDescription:
Introducing a very pretty wedding inspired watercolor floral pack. This set features burgundy and purple garden roses, red berries, and green leaves. With this set you can create unique wedding cards, home decor elements, beautiful greeting cards. The files are PNG, so they can be used with any photo editing program like Photoshop, Canva, PicMonkey, etc.

♡What is included:

14 arrangements size approx.: 17″x 14″; and smaller | png
7 wreaths |frames size approx.: 16″x 18″; and smaller 300 dpi | png
70 elements size approx.: 7″x 6″; and smaller | png
4 borders size approx.: 18″x 3″; and smaller | png
4 seamless patterns size.: 12″x 12″; | png & jpeg
All files are high resolution (300dpi) and have a transparent background (.png), (for patterns additional jpegs with a color background).
